scope: Normal captured LW V10 carrier only; identify source-backed dry-column reconstruction and existing authenticated targets. No opacity reconstruction, solver, RTE, WRF, or tolerance evaluation was run.

input.magic_and_shape: LW V10; nc=1, nl=45; NATIVE_DRY_LAYER_MASS_KG_M2 has shape 1x32; PLEV has 46 interfaces; H2O has 45 layers.
input.interpretation: This is the ordinary native-32 plus extension-13 carrier. The supplied dry-mass vector covers only the first 32 layers.

authenticated_numeric_target.availability: An authenticated no-N2-override output target exists for the normal carrier. The six replay outputs cover six captured states, but no N2=0 or N2=0.7808 output target on this normal 32+13 dry-mass path was found in the reviewed artifacts.

locations: lines 701-703: initialize all layers with get_col_dry(H2O, PLEV*100), then replace only 1:n_native from supplied mass
read_section_flexible: zeros the destination and reads only the provided native prefix
lines 1607-1667: get_col_dry; default gravity branch and Helmert moist-air calculation

constants.parameters: m_h2o=0.018016 kg/mol; avogad=6.02214076e23 mol^-1; m_dry default=0.028964 kg/mol; grav default=9.80665 m/s^2

required_normal_reconstruction: Parse the 32 supplied masses as the native prefix and reproduce the source expression/order: native_col_dry = native_mass * avogad / (m_dry * 10000). Do not replace this with an algebraically rearranged expression when making a source-order claim.

For layers 33-45, independently evaluate the pinned get_col_dry source expression from the V10 H2O layer vmr and adjacent PLEV interfaces converted from hPa to Pa, using the default gravity path (no latitude argument). Preserve the source order: delta_plev=abs(p_i-p_(i+1)); fact=1/(1+vmr); m_air=(m_dry+m_h2o*vmr)*fact; col=10*delta_plev*avogad*fact/(1000*m_air*100*g0).

Only after constructing the complete 45-layer column may a future authorized reconstruction compare it with the saved GAS_COL_DRY target and proceed to independent absorption terms. The saved GAS_COL_DRY must not be used as an input to construct dry columns.

matched_45_counterfactual.scope: This earlier diagnostic deliberately supplies 45 mass values and is not the normal native32+extension13 state. Its N2 absent/zero/0.7808 outputs cannot substitute for missing N2 variants on the normal carrier.

opacity_point_plan_context.required_plan_delta: The existing point reconstruction plan is diagnostic for the all-45 matched-mass input. A normal-carrier plan must switch to the V10 input/output/execution pins above; derive the first 32 dry columns from the native mass section and the final 13 from the source-pinned get_col_dry expression; then independently construct table coordinates/major/minor terms. Keep the existing matched-45 case as a separate carrier, do not mutate or reinterpret its result. The normal carrier presently has an authenticated default-N2 target only; N2=0 and N2=0.7808 require new authorized captures if those cases are needed.

limitations: This is a source and target inventory only. No dry-column reconstruction, opacity calculation, solver call, model call, or RTE call occurred.
An authenticated target file does not by itself establish that an independent reconstruction agrees with it.
No numerical target for N2=0 or N2=0.7808 on the normal 32+13 carrier was identified in this bounded inventory.
